column1: DO NOT SHARE THIS FILE WITH THE ATHLETE
=== CONSEQUENCE POOL (rotate
1. 30-minute walk before 8 AM
2. Whole foods only for the full next day
3. 10-minute meditation or breathwork before bed
4. 5-minute cold shower to start the day
5. 20 minutes stretching/mobility before next workout
6. No phone first hour after waking
7. 15-minute journaling session on training goals
8. Cook every single meal from scratch tomorrow
9. 200 bodyweight squats spread throughout the day
10. No music during next workout - full mind-muscle focus
11. 10-minute sun exposure within 30 min of waking
12. Drink 4L water before noon tomorrow
13. 100 push-ups spread throughout the day (not near push workout)
14. No sitting for more than 30 min at a time tomorrow
15. 20-minute yoga/stretching session before bed
16. Prep and measure every meal the night before
17. 15-minute posing practice session
18. No social media until after workout is complete
19. Hand-write your next day's meal plan on paper
20. 5-minute gratitude list before bed
=== POSITIVE REINFORCEMENT POOL (for sustained consistency) ===
1. Earned cheat meal - one meal of anything
2. Rest day guilt-free - skip a scheduled workout
3. Buy yourself one piece of new gym gear (under $30)
4. Movie night - no alarm next morning
5. One dessert of choice added to daily macros (counted but allowed)
6. Skip cardio for the full week
7. Pick one exercise you hate and swap it out for one you enjoy for a week
8. Treat yourself to a massage or spa session
9. New playlist/album purchase for gym sessions
10. Coach's pick: I choose your entire workout split for a "fun day" - all favorite exercises
11. Unlock a training PR attempt day - pick one lift and go for a true max
12. Extra rest day added to the week
13. Free pass on one future consequence
=== TRIGGER RULES ===
Consequence triggers:
- Missed progression: no weight or rep increase on 2+ tracked lifts vs last session (active after 2 sessions of baseline data per lift)
- Missed calories: more than 300 cal over or under target
- Skipped consequence confirmation: double consequence next day
- Deload weeks exempt from progression trigger
Positive reinforcement triggers (coach discretion):
- 7+ consecutive days hitting calorie target within range
- Progressive overload hit on every tracked lift across a full rotation
- Completing all assigned consequences without complaint
- Hitting weekly weight trend target for 2+ consecutive weeks
- Any notable milestone (bodyweight PR
- Minimum threshold: at least 10 days of consistency before first reward
